cells.gaps: No figures of South Sudan's own traffic under the One Network Area are held; the 900-fold rise is for the partner states together, and its November 2023 communique is at the edge of the three years.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-09: the Northern Corridor ICT ministers' communique of 9 November 2023, attended by South Sudan's minister, reports the One Network Area operational with traffic up over 900 times among the partner states (SSD-008), so what South Sudan put into effect (SSD-007) is reported in use.
